title: Demo: Cancellation Policy (Synthetic)
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMO CONTENT — not real RCG policy.
content: This synthetic demo cancellation policy describes how guests may cancel a cruise booking in the proof-of-concept system. Cancellations made 90 or more days before departure receive a full refund of the cruise fare deposit in demo mode. Cancellations 60–89 days before departure incur a 50% penalty on the cruise fare. Cancellations within 59 days are non-refundable in this demo. Travel insurance, taxes, and fees follow the same demo schedule. No live payment processing occurs in Voyage Canvas; checkout handoff is simulated separately.
